item.title: Harris Literacy Center at Augusta University takes home $20,000 state literacy award
item.description: The Georgia Council on Literacy named the Dr. Paulette P. Harris Literacy Center at Augusta University a 2026 Georgia Reads Community Award recipient. item.title: POST OKs probable cause, sanctions in school officer cheating case
item.description: The Georgia Peace Officer Standards and Training Council agreed Wednesday to approve imposing sanctions against two Richmond County school resource officers accused in a 2024 cheating scandal.
